subject: BlueBridge SOC 2 recertification: evidence schedule, retention uplift & capacity
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Selena Park <selena@bluebridge.com>, Matt Evans <matt.evans@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueBridge SOC 2 recertification: evidence schedule, retention uplift & capacity

Hi Selena / Matt —

Quick note as we kick off the renewal conversation. BlueBridge’s annual contract comes up in November; we want to align on the SOC 2 recert timeline and two asks from your side that will affect pricing and SLOs:

1) Evidence schedule: we can start a phased evidence transfer the week of Oct 19. To keep the audit window tight, we recommend a prioritized handoff for auth logs, change logs, and ingest traces first. I’ve attached an evidence-index-template that maps artifacts to owners.

2) Retention uplift: your compliance team asked about extending retention for audit logs. We can offer 24 months, but that requires a retention+storage fee and a short lead time to provision archival replay pipelines. If you want 24 months instead of our standard 12/18 options, we should lock that in before Nov 1.

3) Capacity planning: recert spikes (bulk exports + replay) will bump token/log throughput. For planning, we estimate a ~20% throughput uplift across Q4–Q1 during evidence staging and testing. We can route burst capacity but it’s easier if we provision a temporary dedicated pool for two months.

Action items from our side: final checklist (attached), proposed retention pricing (coming from Ben), and a technical handoff doc from Kimberly. Could you confirm: preferred evidence window (Oct 19–30 or Nov 2–13), target retention (12/18/24 months), and whether procurement needs a formal SOW to proceed?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call this week to walk through.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-index-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. We’re leaning toward the Oct 19–30 window to avoid market close activities in early November. A few quick Qs:

- Can you provide a single consolidated checklist that maps Redwood owners to our audit contacts? Our audit lead is Priya Shah (priya.shah@bluebridge.com).
- On retention: 24 months is preferred by our legal team, but procurement will push back on price. Can Redwood confirm whether the archived logs will be immutable and searchable for auditors (we need export and replay capability)?
- For capacity: if we agree to a temporary dedicated pool, what’s the expected lead time and cost estimate?

If you can send a short pricing snapshot and the consolidated checklist I’ll loop in Priya and our external auditor.

Best,

Selena — thanks. Attached is a consolidated checklist that ties each artifact to the Redwood contact and a short note on format (PDF, CSV export, system dump). On your questions:

- Immutability & searchability: yes — retained logs are write-once in our archival tier and are indexed for auditor search. We'll provide an auditor-facing export job and a replay API for sample replays. Kimberly will share the technical flow.
- Lead time for dedicated pool: 10 business days to provision and validate. We can start the provisioning once procurement signs the SOW.
- Cost snapshot: Ben, can you attach the retention pricing and the temporary pool estimate? We discussed a 20% uplift sizing for the dedicated pool in the notes.

If procurement needs SOW language, Laura can pick up the contract text / term changes.

Thanks — I’ll keep Oct 19–30 as the target unless you ask otherwise.

Jonas

Attachments: consolidated-evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Selena Park <selena@bluebridge.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Technical: log retention & export flow for BlueBridge recertification

Hi Selena / Jonas —

Attaching a short schematic of the log preservation pipeline and the auditor export job. Key notes:

- Retention tiers: hot (30d), warm (31–365d), archival (>365d). For a 24-month retention we keep an indexed archival tier with HMAC-based immutability markers.
- Export formats: CSV (for ingest traces), gzipped JSON (for full system traces), and a per-audit SQL snapshot.
- Search: auditor queries are supported via a read-only query endpoint that returns time-bounded slices and md5 checksums for verification.
- Throughput: during the export window we’ll throttle non-audit traffic to preserve export bandwidth; if BlueBridge prefers zero throttling we’ll need the dedicated pool.

I’ve placed a technical backup folder on Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX-example-Link-BlueBridge-evidence

Kimberly Park
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: log-preservation-schematic.png (image stub)

Subject: Pricing snapshot: retention uplift & temporary dedicated pool (BlueBridge)

Hi Selena / Matt —

Attached is a short pricing summary:
- 12 months (standard): no change to current fees.
- 18 months: +6% on baseline storage and +4% on export bandwidth during staging.
- 24 months: +12% on baseline storage and +9% on export bandwidth.
- Temporary dedicated pool (2 months): estimated $18k–$25k depending on validation window and replay intensity.

We can offer a 15% one-time discount on the additional retention fees if BlueBridge signs a 24-month retention commitment and a 12-month seat/usage extension. If you want a formal SOW and quote for procurement, Laura can finalize the language.

Attaching versioned quote: BB-upgrade-pricing-v2.pdf

Thanks,
